reply: ClassGrid is a platform for schools, colleges, and institutes to run classes, attendance, communication, and operations in one place. Learn more: https://classgrid.in

Institutions join Classgrid through Book a Demo, not self-serve sign-up. Visit https://classgrid.in/#demo, share your institution details and requirements, and the Classgrid team will review the request and connect to schedule a demo discussion.
Yes — ClassGrid supports colleges and higher-ed workflows alongside schools and coaching centers. See https://classgrid.in/use-cases/college

Parent access depends on how your school configures ClassGrid. Many schools enable parent logins for notices, fees, and student progress. Ask your institution’s admin for an invite or parent portal link.
Pricing is tailored to institution size and modules. See https://classgrid.in/pricing — or reply here with your school/city and we’ll route you to the team.
Thanks for reaching out. For account-specific help, email support@classgrid.in with your school name and phone number. We’ll get back to you as soon as we can.
